questions.question_en: Which city is EW VERDORA based in?
questions.question_zh: EW VERDORA 位于哪个城市？
questions.explanation_en: EW VERDORA is a floral brand based in Kuching, Sarawak.
questions.explanation_zh: EW VERDORA 是位于砂拉越古晋的花艺品牌。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT one of EW VERDORA's five product lines?
questions.question_zh: 以下哪一项不是 EW VERDORA 的五大业务线？
questions.explanation_en: The five lines are condolence, grand opening, bouquets, wedding & event, and wholesale.
questions.explanation_zh: 五大业务线是帛事花圈、开张花篮、精致花束、婚礼与活动、鲜花批发。

questions.question_en: A customer asks why our flowers can stay fresh. What is the honest answer?
questions.question_zh: 客人问为什么我们的花材比较新鲜，诚实的回答是？
options_en: We guarantee every flower lasts two weeks
The company handles its own import documents, air-freights flowers via Kuching Airport and plans with pre-orders; I will still confirm the actual condition
All our flowers are grown in our own farm
options_zh: 保证每朵花都能放两个星期
公司自行处理进口文件，经古晋机场空运清关，并用预订制安排；实际花况我仍会帮你确认
所有花都是我们自己的农场种的
questions.explanation_en: Explain the real process honestly and never guarantee the condition.
questions.explanation_zh: 如实说明流程，不保证花况。

questions.question_en: Which area is within our listed delivery areas?
questions.question_zh: 以下哪个地区在我们列出的配送区域内？
questions.explanation_en: Listed areas: Kuching, Matang, Batu Kawa, Tabuan Jaya, Petra Jaya, Satok, Padawan, Siburan, Samarahan, subject to stock and schedule.
questions.explanation_zh: 配送区域：Kuching、Matang、Batu Kawa、Tabuan Jaya、Petra Jaya、Satok、Padawan、Siburan、Samarahan，视库存与排期。

questions.question_en: A customer asks how much a bouquet costs. What should you do?
questions.question_zh: 客人问一束花多少钱，你应该怎么做？
options_en: Copy the price from an old order
Say a low price first and adjust later
Ask for the date and budget, then request a current quote in the App
options_zh: 问清日期和预算，再在 App 申请当下报价
questions.explanation_en: Prices follow the current quote, which the Agent requests in the App.
questions.explanation_zh: 价格以当下报价为准，由 Agent 在 App 申请。

questions.question_en: A customer sends a photo and asks for the exact same arrangement. Correct reply?
questions.question_zh: 客人发一张图，要求做得一模一样，正确回应是？
options_en: The photo is a style reference; flowers and colours follow the season, and I'll confirm with you first
options_zh: 图片是风格参考，花材和颜色会依当季调整，我会先跟你确认
questions.explanation_en: Photos are style references only and the customer must be told first.
questions.explanation_zh: 图片仅供风格参考，必须先告知客人。

questions.question_en: How does EW VERDORA communicate with customers about orders?
questions.question_zh: EW VERDORA 跟客人沟通订单主要通过什么方式？
options_en: An online shopping cart with automatic payment
questions.explanation_en: There is no shopping cart; details are confirmed directly on WhatsApp.
questions.explanation_zh: 不用购物车，细节通过 WhatsApp 直接确认。

questions.question_en: A customer asks if a certain flower is in stock right now and you are not sure. What do you say?
questions.question_zh: 客人问某种花现在有没有货，你不确定，应该怎么说？
options_en: Say yes so you do not lose the sale
Say you will confirm with the company and get back to them
options_zh: 说我帮你跟公司确认，再回复你
questions.explanation_en: Never invent stock; confirm with the company.
questions.explanation_zh: 绝不虚构库存，要跟公司确认。

questions.question_en: What must you complete before you can take customer orders?
questions.question_zh: 你必须完成什么才能开始接单？
options_en: The 7 required courses and the certification exam at 85% or higher
options_zh: 7 个必修课，加上认证考试 85% 以上
在 Facebook 发一次贴文
questions.explanation_en: Unlocking requires the 7 required courses plus passing certification at 85%.
questions.explanation_zh: 解锁接单需要完成 7 个必修课，并通过 85% 的认证考试。

questions.question_en: A customer says they saw negative reviews online. What is the right approach?
questions.question_zh: 客人说在网上看到负评，正确的做法是？
options_en: Say all bad reviews are fake
Thank them for asking, take it seriously, and offer to confirm any specific concern with the company
options_zh: 谢谢客人直接问，认真看待，并提议把具体担心跟公司确认
questions.explanation_en: Stay honest and respectful; never badmouth others or invent reviews.
questions.explanation_zh: 保持诚实尊重，不贬低别人，也不虚构评价。
